name: Fuuko
source:
Out of the four, she’s the liveliest.
She’s very curious and always wants to know everything. She has a hard time sitting still.
She’s always cheerful and positive, and she’s the one who keeps everyone’s spirits up.
translation:
Out of the four, she’s the liveliest.
She’s very curious and always wants to know everything. She has a hard time sitting still.
She’s always cheerful and positive, and she’s the one who keeps everyone’s spirits up.
